Name: Sync Incidents V2
Author: Admin

Parameters.Description: The name of the environment from which to sync incidents.
Your unique directory ID in Azure, also known as your tenant ID.
The URL for the OAuth 2.0 endpoint where the job will request an authentication token.
The base URL for the Management API. The job will append specific API calls to this root URL to retrieve data.
The unique ID of the application registered in Azure Active Directory that is granted permissions to access Microsoft Sentinel.
The confidential key for the application, used in conjunction with the Client ID to authenticate and authorize the job.
The number of hours to synchronize incidents prior to the current time. The default value is `24`.
If enabled, job will sync assignee from Microsoft Sentinel to Google SecOps.
If selected, the integration validates the SSL certificate when connecting to the Microsoft Sentinel server. Enabled by default.

Description: Use the Sync Incidents V2 job to synchronize Google SecOps alerts with Microsoft Sentinel incidents. This job ensures that comments, statuses, and tags are synchronized bi-directionally between both systems. Note: Assignee and severity synchronization occurs exclusively from Microsoft Sentinel to Google SecOps. For the job to identify the correct information, the Google SecOps case must have the Microsoft Sentinel Incident tag. This job only works on alerts from the Microsoft Azure Sentinel Incident Connector v2.
